result:
Excellent! All components are working correctly. Here's a summary of the implementation:

## Changes Made for Scheduled Post Publishing

### Database & Schema
- **`db/schema.ts`**: Added `publishedAt: text('published_at')` nullable column to posts table
- **Migration**: Generated migration `20260929170446_add_published_at_to_posts` to add the column

### Models & Resources
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: Added `publishedAt` to fillable fields
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`**: Added `publishedAt` to serialization, converting stored ISO strings to ISO string format

### Validation & API
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: Added `publishAt: z.string().datetime().optional().nullable()` field to accept ISO 8601 timestamps

### Controllers - Post Visibility Logic
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**:
  - Added `isPostPublished()` helper: returns true if no date or date is in the past
  - **index()**: Filters to show scheduled posts only to their author
  - **search()**: Filters to show scheduled posts only to their author  
  - **show()**: Returns 404 for scheduled posts to non-authors, 200 for authors
  - **store()**: Maps `publishAt` request field to `publishedAt` database column
  - **update()**: Maps `publishAt` field when updating posts

- **`app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.ts`**: Filters latest posts to exclude scheduled posts for non-authors

### Console Command
- **`app/Console/Commands/PostsScheduledCommand.ts`**: Lists all scheduled posts (where published_at > now), sorted by soonest first, in format: `<id>\t<title>\t<published_at>`
- **`src/console.ts`**: Registered the command

The implementation correctly handles:
- ✅ Posts with future publish dates visible only to authors
- ✅ Posts with past/no dates visible to everyone
- ✅ Time-based visibility with no additional action required
- ✅ Invalid date rejection via Zod datetime validation
- ✅ Console report of scheduled posts
